hook.line: The espresso machine broke again and a customer waited forty minutes. A plain sorry feels thin, so Spanish has a proper way to apologise and say what for.
hook.es: Le pido disculpas por la demora.

examples.es: Le pido disculpas por la demora.
examples.en: I apologise for the delay. (to a customer, formal)

examples.es: Te pido perdón por no llamarte.
examples.en: I'm sorry for not calling you. (to a friend)

examples.es: Disculpa, es que no te vi.
examples.en: Sorry, it's just that I didn't see you. (to a friend)

examples.es: Les pido disculpas por el ruido.
examples.en: I apologise to you all for the noise.
Excuse me, it's just that I didn't know. (formal)

examples.es: Mariana me pidió disculpas por la broma.
examples.en: Mariana apologised to me for the joke.

rule:
To apologise properly, *pedir disculpas* or *pedir perdón*, then *por* and the reason. The reason is a noun (*por la demora*) or an infinitive (*por llegar tarde*). Who you apologise to goes before the verb: *te* for a friend, *le* for *usted*, *les* for you all.
For a quick sorry, say *Disculpa* or *Disculpe*, then *es que* and your reason: "it's just that".
Keep one register: *disculpa* goes with *tú*, *disculpe* with *usted*.
smallPrint: Teachers call *te*, *le* and *les* here indirect object pronouns: they name the person who receives the apology.

readAndPick.es: Le pido disculpas por la demora.
options: I apologise for the delay, speaking to a stranger.
I apologise for the delay, speaking to a close friend.

readAndPick.es: Te pido perdón por no llamarte.
options: I'm sorry you didn't call me.
I'm sorry for not calling you.

readAndPick.es: Mariana me pidió disculpas por la broma.
options: I apologised to Mariana for the joke.
Mariana apologised to me for the joke.

readAndPick.es: Les pido disculpas por el ruido.
options: I apologise to him for the noise.
I apologise to you for the noise.
I apologise to you all for the noise.
Sorry (to a friend), it's just that I didn't know.
Excuse me (to a stranger), it's just that I didn't know.

readAndPick.es: Te pido perdón por llegar tarde.
No te pido perdón por eso.
options: I'm not forgiving you for that.
I'm not apologising to you for that.

yourTurn.prompt: Pick and type the whole sentence: *Le pido disculpas ___ la demora.* (*por* or *para*) I apologise for the delay. (formal)
yourTurn.answer: Le pido disculpas por la demora.
yourTurn.why: After saying sorry, the reason comes with *por*.

yourTurn.prompt: Pick and type the whole sentence: *___ pido perdón por llegar tarde.* (*Te* or *Le*) To a friend: I'm sorry for being late.
yourTurn.answer: Te pido perdón por llegar tarde.
accept: Te pido disculpas por llegar tarde.
yourTurn.why: A friend is *tú*, so *te*; *le* is for *usted*.

yourTurn.prompt: To a friend: Sorry, it's just that I didn't see you.
yourTurn.answer: Disculpa, es que no te vi.
accept: Perdona, es que no te vi.
Perdóname, es que no te vi.
yourTurn.why: A quick sorry plus *es que* gives your reason.

yourTurn.prompt: To your neighbours (you all): I apologise for the noise.
yourTurn.answer: Les pido disculpas por el ruido.
accept: Les pido perdón por el ruido.
yourTurn.why: *Les* is for more than one person, and *por* brings in the reason.

yourTurn.prompt: To a woman you've just met (formal): I'm sorry for not calling you.
yourTurn.answer: Le pido perdón por no llamarla.
accept: Le pido disculpas por no llamarla.
yourTurn.why: *Le* goes with *usted*, and *por* plus an infinitive gives the reason.

yourTurn.prompt: Make it polite (*usted*): *Disculpa, es que no sabía.*
Make it negative: *Te pido perdón por eso.*
yourTurn.answer: No te pido perdón por eso.

pitfalls.wrong: Le pido disculpas para la demora.
pitfalls.right: Le pido disculpas por la demora.
pitfalls.why: Almost. The reason for an apology comes with *por*, never *para*.

pitfalls.wrong: Te pido disculpas de llegar tarde.
pitfalls.right: Te pido disculpas por llegar tarde.
pitfalls.why: Close. English says "sorry for", and Spanish says *por*.

pitfalls.wrong: Disculpe, es que no te vi.
pitfalls.right: Disculpe, es que no lo vi.
pitfalls.why: Stay in one register: *disculpe* is for *usted*, so the person is *lo* or *la*, not *te*.

personal: Think of something small you got wrong this week. Write *Te pido perdón por…* with an infinitive, then *Disculpa, es que…* with your reason.
